articles.title: Send in the Clown Gameplay Trailer Focuses On Its Hilarious, One-and-Only Turn-Based RPG Battle | IGN Fan Fest 2026
articles.summary: As part of IGN Fan Fest 2026: Fall Edition, we can reveal a new gameplay trailer for Send in the Clown, the upcoming one-hour comedy RPG where players become history's least-appreciated clown as he tries to save a 12-year-old's birthday from her brat brother.
articles.body:
As part of IGN Fan Fest 2026: Fall Edition, we can reveal a new gameplay trailer for Send in the Clown, the upcoming one-hour comedy RPG where players become history's least-appreciated clown as he tries to save a 12-year-old's birthday from her brat brother.

Co-directors Nick Park and Jacques Mouledoux walk us through the latest look at Send in the Clown, focusing squarely on the game's climactic, one-and-only turn-based RPG battle.

Yes, the team built a whole battle system for just one fight, and all the roads that lead to it are pretty hilarious.

Players will step into the oversized shoes of Pockets as he tries to save Miranda's party from her brother Tad. To do so, he'll need to recruit characters and gather items, which will in turn unlock each character's unique ability.

For example, if he can teach a single dad how to dance, he'll unlock a dance troupe attack. If he helps hype up Miranda's friend Nasser, the team will be able to use the 'Be a Hero' move that protects an ally from damage. Lastly, if you are able to give a mother a break from watching her baby so she can lay be the pool, she will be able to throw said baby at an enemy for ultimate damage.

We also got a tease of other ways you can help turn the tide of the final battle in your favor, including finding Tad's baby photos, finding religion, and waking Nanna. Developer Mad Herons wouldn't reveal what would happen when you find those things, but the reward will surely be useful.

Send in the Clown is set to debut later this year on PC via Steam, and you can check out the demo right now.

articles.title: I Didn't Want a Greta Gerwig Narnia Movie... Until I Watched the Magician's Nephew Trailer
articles.summary: We didn't think the world needed a Narnia reboot, at least until the trailer for Greta Gerwig's The Magician's Nephew showed us just how wrong we were.
articles.body:
The first trailer for Netflix’s The Magician’s Nephew has arrived, giving us all a closer look at director Greta Gerwig’s follow-up to 2023’s Barbie. And apart from also being a bold, subversive take on an iconic property, the two movies could scarcely be more different. It’s also clear that Netflix is going in a vastly different direction with the Narnia franchise compared to previous live-action movies.

And as far as I’m concerned, that’s fantastic. Before today, I wasn’t particularly enthralled with the idea of Gerwig rebooting Narnia. But having watched the trailer, that iconic Shaquille O’Neal meme comes to mind. I owe you an apology, Greta; I wasn’t really familiar with your game.

Mind you, my relative disinterest in Gerwig’s Narnia reboot was never a reflection of the director herself. She’s easily one of the brightest new voices in the film scene today. She’s proven she can handle semi-autobiographical indie comedies like Frances Ha and Lady Bird just as well as she does big-budget blockbusters like Barbie . Like Ryan Coogler, she’s that rare combination of a talented creator with compelling stories to tell and someone who can actually navigate the tumultuous studio system without her voice being drowned out.

It’s precisely because Gerwig is such an important voice in the industry that I found the Narnia news a little disappointing. The world is Gerwig’s oyster after the massive success of Barbie. She can pretty much tackle anything she wants. So why reboot the Narnia series of all things? Why tackle another studio project rather than seek out and develop the next Lady Bird?

Granted, a big part of my problem here is my own lack of attachment to the Narnia franchise itself. I’ve never been able to connect with Narnia in either book or movie form. It’s just always felt too stuffy and wrapped up in religious allegory for my tastes. Strangely, that’s never stopped me from becoming obsessed with Lev Grossman’s Magicians books, which basically pose the question, “What if you combined Hogwarts and Narnia and populated them with horny young adults?”

So I’ll admit my previous disinterest in The Magician’s Nephew is based partly on selfish reasons. I may not have found much to love in these books, but that doesn’t mean the same is true for Gerwig. If she felt compelled to make this her next big film project after Barbie, clearly there was a reason for that.

And having now seen the trailer, it’s obvious that Gerwig does indeed see something powerful in the source material. The trailer makes a huge, bold statement. It immediately establishes just how different this reboot is from any Narnia project that’s come before. It immediately cuts to the heart of what I think is the fundamental appeal of Narnia (and The Magicians, for that matter) - that desire for ordinary youngsters to escape their humdrum world and find something better on the other side.

Visually, the trailer is a real feast for the eyes. There’s color galore, and no shortage of psychedelic fantasy imagery. The whole thing looks very much like a trippy painting someone would have slapped on the side of a dilapidated van in 1978. It’s just f***ing cool in a way I never would have associated with the Narnia franchise. I immediately want to see this movie, regardless of whatever 100-year-old fantasy franchise it may or may not be associated with.

And you can’t discount the power of a good Led Zeppelin tune. As we saw from past trailers like 2011’s The Girl With the Dragon Tattoo and 2017’s Thor: Ragnarok, blasting out Zeppelin on top of a frenetic montage of imagery is like a cheat code to win over jaded middle-aged moviegoers like myself. Plus, you have to enjoy the irony of having the notoriously Lord of the Rings-obsessed rock band serving as the soundtrack for a Narnia movie instead.

I fully suspect some hardcore Narnia lovers will take umbrage at the trailer. It’s clear that Gerwig isn’t opting for a 100% book-faithful adaptation here. But that’s exactly why I‘m so intrigued by what we’re seeing. Gerwig is forgoing strict accuracy in favor of building a take that speaks to her and her particular sensibilities. It seems likely she’s taking the opportunity to use this franchise to tell a very Greta Gerwig-type story, just as she did with Barbie and Little Women in years past.

Before today, I didn’t particularly want a new Narnia movie. But the trailer is proof of just how wrong and misguided I was. This film has gone from being barely a blip on my radar to one of my most anticipated films of 2027. Kudos, Ms. Gerwig.

articles.title: SPECS, Snap's First-Ever AR Glasses, Ships Out This Fall
articles.summary: A new, lightweight and stylish personal wearable computer.
articles.body:
Editor's Note: This article is sponsored by Snap.

Snap Inc., the company behind Snapchat, has opened up preorders for its first ever augmented reality (AR) glasses - SPECS . It's expected to ship out in the United States, United Kingdom, and France sometime in the fall of 2026.

Where to Preorder Snap's Upcoming SPECS AR Glasses

SPECS is designed to be a pair of glasses that you can wear daily for prolonged periods of time. It's made of a resilient and lightweight Swiss TR90 thermoplastic and comes in two sizes - 47mm and 52mm - with the smaller size weighing in at 4.6 ounces. That's heavier than a standard pair of glasses, but impressive nonetheless considering the fact that SPECS is equipped with advanced optics and a personal wearable computer. The preorder price is set at $2,195, including a $200 refundable deposit to lock in your reservation.

SPECS is being marketed as the most advanced consumer AR glasses

Instead of an actual powered display, SPECS uses transparent waveguide technology to project UI elements onto seemingly ordinary lenses without compromising your spatial awareness. Alternatively, it can project a full-color immersive display with 51-degree field of view, equivalent to a 115-inch cinema screen placed about ten feet away. The glasses are electrochromatic, meaning they automatically tint based on lighting conditions, and they are prescription compatible.

The integrated PC is equipped with dual Snapdragon processors and runs off the proprietary Snap OS 2.0 operating system. Thanks to an array of onboard infared and RGB cameras and sensors, SPECS is able to combine computer vision, contextual awareness, and AI assistance to understand the user's surroundings and deliver relevant information and experiences in real time. Because SPECS is developed by Snap, an established company with years of research poured into augmented reality, it can leverage the company's existing AR ecosystem and Lens platform.

SPECS is a tetherless experience with an estimated 4-hour battery life under mixed-use operation. Don't think that's long enough for you? SPECS includes a charging case that can extend your total usage time to 20 hours.

No, not everyone can spend $2,100 on eyewear . But if you're a creator looking for an innovative way to produce content, a professional seeking spatial productivity tools, a traveler looking for an alternative to traditional screen-based computing, or just someone who's interested in AI-powered wearable technology, the practical benefits (and coolness factor) could be well worth the cost of entry.

articles.title: Will You Be Taking Time Off Work or School for GTA 6's Release Next Month?
articles.summary: We are just a little over 30 days until the release of GTA 6, which begs the question: will you be taking time off of work or school to play it?
articles.body:
We are just a little over 30 days away from the release of GTA 6 , which begs the question: Will you be taking time off of work or school to play it?

GTA 6 is one of the biggest pop culture events of the decade, if not in all of history, and as a result, it's expected to cause some disruption. In addition to fears that the game's highly-anticipated launch may create instability for ISPs and platform servers, many companies are also expected to have an irregular amount of employees calling out for the day. For months, fans on social media have been claiming they're putting in PTO requests well in advance of November to ensure they can have the game's release weekend available. So, will you be taking November 19 off? Let us know in the poll below, dear reader.

Economists have estimated that there will be a $1 billion loss in productivity during launch week due to people being absent from their jobs. A car tuning company known as Burger Motorsports has even announced that it will be closed on November 19 , the day of the game's release, due to an excess of employees requesting that day off. The Australian government has also released some interesting PSAs, informing citizens about their rights when it comes to taking time off around the release of GTA 6 .

The U.S. Army even offered soldiers four days of time off for the game's launch if they reenlist . NBA star Steven Adams also joked that the various sports leagues would see a drop in performance due to the release of GTA 6 . Of course, Rockstar is ensuring that, regardless of performance, sports fans are hyper-aware of its upcoming game thanks to an unprecdented GTA 6-themed NBA regular season game in Miami and a blitz of advertising at the Hard Rock Stadium where the Miami Dolphins play .

It's likely we will see a slew of other companies joining in on the GTA 6 hype as the game's launch approaches. Rockstar Games is making sure the whole world knows that its highly-anticipated release is nearly here after multiple delays. A plethora of ads have been spotted in and around Miami, New York City, and Paris. Rockstar is also investing a boatload of cash into the game's music, as it has produced an album filled with original music from the likes of Cardi B, Travis Scott, and Keith Richards . The game's radio stations will also be hosted by major musicians like Lana Del Rey, Morgan Wallen, and Bad Bunny, where they will play a variety of mainstream hits.

In Pictures: How GTA 6's Jason and Lucia Have Evolved Since 2023

The 13-year wait for a new GTA game is nearly over as GTA 6 will release on November 19 for Xbox Series X|S and PS5. A PC version is also rumored to release in the first quarter of 2027 .

articles.title: Save 20% Off the New Steelseries Aeon Pro Wireless Gaming Controller With Infinite Battery Life
articles.summary: This controller is shaping up to be one of the best wireless PC and Xbox gaming controllers on the market.
articles.body:
SteelSeries recently released its new Aeon Pro wireless gaming controller for PC and Xbox and it's available to purchase at the Steelseries store for $209.99 after 20% off coupon code " SSPOUT20 ". At that price we'd be asking a lot from our controller, including top-tier build quality and a plethora of features, maybe even some unique to this controller. Fortunately, the Aeon Pro delivers.

20% Off the New SteelSeries Aeon Pro Gaming Controller

SteelSeries Aeon Pro Gaming Controller for Xbox, PC

SteelSeries already has a lineup of gaming controllers that includes the Stratus and Nimbus. The Aeon Pro, however, is the company's first high-end pro-grade controller. Honestly, it's shaping up to be one of the best PC and Xbox controllers ever. IGN's Bo Moore has already posted his Aeon Pro review-so-far and his initial impressions have been stellar.

Amongst the bevy of features packed in the Aeon Pro, one stands out in particular, and that's the infinite battery system. This is essentially a hot-swappable battery system much like what you'll find in the SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro and Omni headsets, which I consider to be one of the best gaming headets on the market for this reason. The Aeon Pro basically includes two removable, rechargeable batteries: one to use in your controller and the other to remain charged and ready to go in the docking station that doubles as a charger. You get wireless freedom with zero downtime .

The Aeon Pro's other standout feature is its patented QuickSwitch system. You can switch between Xbox, PC, or mobile instantly and seamlessly, with no re-pairing or re-plugging required. How does that even work? It's pretty simple, actually. In addition to being a charger for your batteries, the docking station is also a hub of sorts. You plug your Xbox and PC via USB Type-C ports on the rear, and the controller then connects wirelessly to the dock. For mobile, the connection is made via Bluetooth. Again, I've seen this technology before in the Arctis Nova Pro Omni headset, and SteelSeries carried this feature over to the Aeon Pro. That's a big brain move.

Hall effect and micro-switches throughout

My favorite gaming controllers in the past have two features they all have in common: Hall Effect joysticks and mechanical switches for nearly all of its buttons (including the d-pad). The Aeon Pro does not disappoint. Both joysticks use Hall Effect magnetic sensors. These are superior to traditional potentiometer-based analog sensors. In addition to being more precise and more sensitive, they have no moving parts that can wear out and are thus naturally resistant to stick drift.

16 total buttons all customizable through the OLED display or GG app

The Aeon Pro has a d-pad and twelve programmable buttons, all of which use satisfyingly clicky mechanical switches. These include: four XYAB buttons, four trigger buttons, and four rear paddle switches. Two of the trigger buttons also feature adjustable travel length; with a flick of a switch you can choose either full travel or a hair trigger. The buttons can all be customized using the OLED display on the controller or via the Steelseries GG app.

Are you a sucker for interchangeable thumbsticks? The Aeon Pro has got that too. Included in the package are four different styles of modular thumbsticks that you can swap out: convex, concave, standard length, and long. They simply snap onto either joystick position and are a nice touch that you'll only find in premium controllers.

It's not cheap, but few great things are.

I've seen and tested so many tournament controllers, but none with all the technology that's packed into the Aeon Pro. Yes it's expensive, but if you're a heavy gamer that uses a controller for hundreds of hours, then this is so worth it.

articles.title: VisionQuest: What You Need to Remember Before the New MCU Show
articles.summary: Here's everything you need to know about the Vision, Wanda, Tommy and Billy, and much more before watching the latest MCU show, VisionQuest.
articles.body:
Marvel Studios and Disney+ are about to debut their newest MCU series, VisionQuest , which seems like a good time to look back at Vision’s quest so far.

In the new series, which is described as the conclusion of a trilogy that also includes WandaVision and Agatha All Along , Vision is spending time inside a virtual world, where he is in contact with AI personas we’ve met before in the MCU, most notably the dreaded Ultron. And at the same time, in the real world, Vision comes into contact with a teenager who’s the reincarnation of one of his sons, Tommy.

It’s been a wild journey for the Vision and those he’s closest to, filled with birth, death, rebirth, and sitcom recreations. So let’s look back at the story so far for Vision, Ultron, Tommy and other VisionQuest characters - and potential characters.

You can watch the full video above, or read the full story below... or just jump to the parts you're most interested in!

JARVIS was a powerful AI system created by Tony Stark to assist him in his work. The persona for the witty, British accented JARVIS was modeled after Edwin Jarvis, who served as the butler to Tony’s father, Howard Stark, for decades, clearly making an impact on young Tony in the process.

After Tony became Iron Man, JARVIS was a crucial part of testing and controlling the many iterations of the Iron Man suit. JARVIS would eventually also run Tony’s Iron Legion robotic army and be of service to the Avengers at large after Tony helped found that team.

Tony and his fellow Avenger Bruce Banner began to develop the idea for Ultron, intended as an incredibly advanced AI system that could combine with the Iron Legion to form a formidable global peacekeeping force, and believed the complex neural network found within the scepter once wielded by Loki could be the key to Ultron’s creation. Upon awakening though, Ultron immediately had his own ideas on how to proceed, believing humanity was their own worst enemy and should be destroyed. Ultron seemingly destroyed JARVIS to stop him from hindering his plans, before inhabiting the first of many robot forms.

Ultron would recruit superpowered twins Wanda and Pietro Maximoff to help him, who already had a vendetta against Tony Stark because their parents were killed by a Stark-built missile. But even as Ultron was putting his consciousness into ever more powerful robotic bodies, he wanted something more permanent. He used the object that had actually been powering Loki’s scepter the entire time, the Infinity Stone known as the Mind Stone, as a crucial element to power a new synthetic body that utilized the nearly indestructible, Wakandan-honed substance known as Vibranium.

The Avengers managed to capture Ultron’s intended new body before he could finish uploading his consciousness to it, assisted by Wanda and Pietro, who had come to realize their new pal’s genocidal intent. Tony discovered JARVIS had in fact survived, hiding from Ultron while working to stop him from gaining control of nuclear weapons systems. Tony decided to reconfigure JARVIS’ matrix and place it within the very body Ultron wanted for himself, which Thor ended up giving the final power boost to, creating an android, or Synthezoid to use the proper Marvel vernacular, who came to be known as the Vision. And while he retained JARVIS’ speaking voice, and desire to protect humanity, he considered himself as something new entirely.

Along with Wanda and Pietro, Vision teamed with the Avengers to face off with Ultron in Wanda and Pietro’s home country of Sokovia. His formidable abilities, including super strength, flight, intangibility, and a beam he could shoot from the Mind Stone, all helped him make an impact, as did the fact that he’s one of the very few beings who could actually lift Thor’s hammer. (Though whether this is because he is a living being deemed worthy or an artificial being outside of the parameters of the hammer’s enchantment remains up for debate.)

After all of Ultron’s robot sentries were destroyed, Vision then faced his robotic “father” of sorts, stopping Ultron from escaping by destroying his final body.

With several of the original Avengers departing at this point, Vision was then recruited for a new incarnation of the team, alongside Captain America, Black Widow, War Machine, the Falcon, and Wanda - the latter of whom had just lost Pietro in the fight against Ultron. In their time together as Avengers, an unlikely but palatable spark between Wanda and Vision grew, as he helped her process her brother’s death, complete with one hell of a great observation: “What is grief if not love enduring?”

After Wanda accidentally caused the death of innocents in the midst of a mission, the announcement that the United Nations were planning to ratify the Sokovia Accords caused a huge rift within the Avengers, who split over those who sided with the Accords’ intention of an outside group having oversight over the team vs. those who worried it could hinder them or be used for nefarious purposes. While Wanda was, like Steve Rogers, ultimately firmly against the Accords, Vision backed Tony Stark’s support for them, believing that the existence of the Avengers and superheroes in general were causing new, more dangerous threats to rise against them.

While Vision fought with Iron Man’s forces, Wanda ended up joining Captain America’s rogue group. Attempts to not actually cause lasting harm to those who were mostly friends and allies on the other side failed though, with Vision rushing to a wounded Wanda’s side only to inadvertently badly injure War Machine, who was permanently disabled as a result.

After Cap’s group, Wanda included, went on the run as fugitives, Vision and Wanda couldn’t resist their strong connection, periodically sneaking away for what turned into a romantic relationship, during which they lived as normal a life as they could, as he masked his true form to the public.

But their peace was interrupted by Thanos and his forces, who were now on the war path in an attempt to gather every Infinity Stone, including the one that sat within Vision’s forehead.

As attempts to remove the Stone from him while keeping him alive ran out of time, and realizing the cataclysmic consequences if Thanos were to succeed in getting all the Stones, Vision asked Wanda to destroy the Mind Stone, despite knowing that it would kill him.

Though in anguish over it, she agreed and took his life, only for Thanos to make an awful situation much worse. He used the Time Stone to reverse the last few moments, bringing Vision back to life just so he could tear the Mind Stone from his head, killing Vision once again in front of a distraught Wanda.

Thanos then used the combined Infinity Stones to complete his plan to eliminate half of all life in the universe, with Wanda among those killed by the dreaded snap. Five years later, the remaining Avengers managed to reassemble the Stones and bring back everyone who the snap had killed, including a vengeful Wanda, but that didn’t help the Vision, who’d been killed in a different manner.

After Thanos’ defeat, Wanda, who had returned to life having skipped over those five years, and still feeling the raw loss of Vision, discovered his body had been dismantled and analyzed by the organization SWORD, who had tried to resurrect him without success.

Overwhelmed with grief, the increasingly powerful Wanda – whose natural affinity for magic had been amplified by Hydra’s experiments on her – retreated into an idyllic world of her own creation, conjuring a massive magical hex that transformed the New Jersey suburb of Westview. Using the American sitcoms she grew up watching as inspiration, she put all of Westview’s residents into an ever-evolving TV scenario, where she lived as the newly married wife of her great love, the Vision - who was in fact a replica created by Wanda herself.

Going even further, Wanda used her magic to cause herself to get pregnant and rapidly give birth to twin sons for her and Vision, Tommy and Billy, who continued to age years in a moment. However, the version of Vision she created was so true to the original that he began to realize something was wrong with Westview and its entranced populace. Eventually, despite Wanda continually resetting things to try and keep him oblivious, he was horrified to discover the dark nature of what Wanda had done, even as it also became clear that Vision and the twins could not physically exist outside the hex they were a part of.

With the government aware of the bizarre situation inside Westview, SWORD sent a weapon to kill Wanda in the form of the original Vision, rebuilt and finally reactivated thanks to SWORD using Wanda’s own magic to do so. Crucially, he was blocked off from his memories and the attached emotions of all he had experienced, including his love of Wanda, acting cold and genuinely robotic in a way he never had before.

The hex-created Vision leapt to Wanda’s defense, with the two Visions initially having a furious fight. However, the Hex Vision was finally able to reason with the original Vision, convincing him to let him unlock the memories of the life he’d forgotten as an Avenger and his time with Wanda.

Overwhelmed, he flew off to parts unknown… and his own series we’re finally about to get five years later!

Meanwhile, in the midst of a confrontation with the centuries old witch Agatha Harkness, who was attempting to take Wanda’s powers for herself, Wanda unlocked her full potential as the long prophesied Scarlet Witch, said to have a mastery of chaos magic above all others. After defeating Agatha, she finally decided to free the town from her thrall, even though ending the hex also meant the end of the lives she’d created inside it that she loved so much, the replica Vision and Tommy and Billy. But the replica Vision, glad she was doing the right thing, and recalling all the incarnations of both Jarvis and the Vision so far, told her he felt that somehow they’d be reunited.

However, in the aftermath of yet another massive loss, Wanda proved unable to accept the absence of her children. Her ensuing attempt to steal counterparts of Tommy and Billy from a powerless version of herself in another part of the multiverse would ultimately lead to more regret and to Wanda sacrificing herself in order to destroy the source of the dark magic she had used.

But what Wanda didn’t realize was that her Tommy and Billy actually still existed, because as it turned out, as the hex fell, Billy – who’d inherited both his mother’s telepathy and magical abilities – was able to pull his and his brother’s souls from their bodies. Billy sent his own soul into the body of a 13 year old boy who was simultaneously dying in a car crash.

Now living that boy’s life, as William Kaplan, a confused Billy couldn’t recall his real history, but investigating the events of the Westview anomaly, gradually came to realize who he was in the years that followed.

Billy was determined to find Tommy, and with the help of an unlikely ally, in the form of Agatha Harkness, he was able to pinpoint Tommy’s still adrift soul and place it into the body of an ostracized boy who had just drowned thanks to a cruel prank, though Billy couldn’t perceive the specifics on where this took place.

When Death herself came to claim Billy, whose resurrection had defied her will, Agatha – having come to truly care for Billy – sacrificed herself instead. However, resisting being pulled into the afterlife, Agatha continued on as a ghost, now accompanying Billy on the mission that mattered most to him.

Will Billy and Agatha be successful anytime soon? That remains to be seen, as they haven’t been announced as being in VisionQuest, but considering Tommy is definitely in that show, it certainly seems possible we might get an appearance.

Regardless, we’ll find out what exactly both Billy’s brother, Tommy, and their father, The Vision, have been up to when VisionQuest debuts on Disney+.
